name: Decorators cannot alter forbidden static-spine identity facts

input.fixture_ref: Apply Class and Contract decorators that attempt each forbidden declaration-kind, identity, package, superclass, Contract, generic and native-layout transformation.

applicability.reason: Requires decorator RESOLUTION. The old reason claimed `@decorator` is a parse diagnostic; re-probed and that is stale: `@Stamp() class A { }` parses, reaches the runtime through `publish_decorators`, and C091's forbidden transforms are already implemented and enforced in `decorator::apply_pending`, covered by the runtime test class_revisions.rs. The real blocker is that source decorators are never resolved to a declaration. `decorator_transforms` maps EVERY decorator to `DecoratorTransform::metadata`, there is no decorator declaration form, and `@Undeclared() class A { }` is accepted, so no source-level decorator can request a forbidden transform. Mapping decorator NAMES onto the forbidden variants would only hard-code this row's fixture, not implement C087 resolution.

expect.status: Every forbidden transform aborts the candidate and no changed nominal identity or static-spine fact is published.
